notes: net::http::cookiejar: Go's RFC 6265 jar with Options and PublicSuffixList, Go's storage, matching, ordering and Punycode host rules, differential-checked by tools/cookiejar_check.py; cookies carry Go's Quoted flag, times have nanosecond resolution, and the golang.org/x/net/idna mapping tables beyond lower-casing are not ported

Jar.Cookies.note: The Quoted flag (Cookie::quoted) is stored with the cookie and returned; expiry and creation times are nanoseconds since the Unix epoch, compared as Go compares time.Time.

Jar.SetCookies.note: Non-ASCII host labels are lower-cased and Punycode-encoded, but the full UTS 46 mapping and validation tables of golang.org/x/net/idna are not ported (no std equivalent).

PublicSuffixList.String.note: PublicSuffixList extends std::fmt::Display, which provides the description
